## Description and Rationale

We are a two-person team of data scientists with some background in aviation, participating in the PRC Data Challenge. We decided to register to gain hands-on experience working with real-world aviation data and to further develop our skills. We are particularly interested in exploring how data-driven approaches can help understand and address challenges in the aviation domain. Through this challenge, we hope to sharpen our technical skills, gain valuable experience, and learn from other participants and the wider aviation and data science community.

* Type: Independent
* Country: Netherlands
